definitions.explanation: Conforming to rules or standards; authorized or proper.

examples.japanese: {正規|せいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んでください→踏む：01197_fumu⟧。

examples.english: I was hired as a regular employee.

examples.japanese: {正規|せいき}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧。
